Ivar and his army lay siege to the city of Annevar, seeking to gain control of the fortified port city. The siege is brutal but short, it is said that Ivar one day grew tired of the city garrison shouting insults about his mother from atop the walls, and with the strength of a thunderstorm he tore the wall down himself. His army flooded into the city, but killed no enemies, taking them all as prisoners or defectors into their own ranks. Ivar established Annevar as a foothold in the west and the trade from the port into the Winterlands granted him greater power. People began to call him the Rebel King or the Uncrowned King.
